<?php
class QuietWeakMapCoalesceGet {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietWeakMapCoalesceRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$held = new WeakMap();
$mapWeak = WeakReference::create($held);
$reader = new QuietWeakMapCoalesceGet;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ?? quietWeakMapCoalesceRight();
echo $answer === $mapWeak->get() ? "SAME;" : "BAD_MAP;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
unset($answer);
echo $mapWeak->get() === null ? "RETIRED;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietWeakMapAssignValue {
    public function __destruct() { echo "VALUE;"; }
}
class QuietWeakMapAssignGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BAD_SET;"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietWeakMapAssignRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$held = new WeakMap();
$key = new stdClass();
$value = new QuietWeakMapAssignValue;
$mapWeak = WeakReference::create($held);
$keyWeak = WeakReference::create($key);
$valueWeak = WeakReference::create($value);
$held[$key] = $value;
unset($value);
$reader = new QuietWeakMapAssignGet;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ??= quietWeakMapAssignRight();
echo $answer === $mapWeak->get() ? "SAME;" : "BAD_MAP;";
echo $answer[$key] === $valueWeak->get() ? "ENTRY;" : "BAD_ENTRY;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
unset($answer);
echo $mapWeak->get() === null && $valueWeak->get() === null ? "RETIRED;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
echo $keyWeak->get() === $key ? "KEY_LIVE;" : "BAD_KEY;";
unset($key);
echo $keyWeak->get() === null ? "KEY_RETIRED;" : "BAD_KEY_OWNER;";
echo "DONE;";
